p.i: nus prose, Cornelio Pastore Firdgumano, & Cœnobio Tiumarumano, Gerbrandus Aysma præpositus Angiumanus, Petrus Purmeranus, Prior Achlemius, Stephanus Eæus, Cellarius Floridi Campi, nomine Præsulis, Petrus Ruardus pro Gerardo Siuckis Priore in Thabor, Iarichus Dekema, & Nicolaus Hanso-nius Iureconsulti pro Franequeranis; Iarichus Dekema, Andreas Waltinga, & Hanso Douwonius pro Territorio Franequerano, D. Horatius Fons, D. Wopko Albada presbyteri, Iulius Botnia, Petrus Walta, Sidsius Sidzii, & Iarichus Tadæus pro Baerderanis; Gerardus Pastor Oosterendius, Siricius Do-nia Prætor, Ruardus Roorda, Gaius Petræus pro Hemmardiis, Adrianus Mi-chaëlius Pro-Prætor, Ielgerus Tierkenius, Sipko Iasperius, Suffridus Tial-lesius, & Hero Lollius pro Barranis; Adrianus Michaëlius pro Harlingiis, Ioannes Herama Prætor, Uldricus Pastor Ferwoldius, Dodo Sixtinus, Mar-tinus Haiomius, Ruardus Feitesius, & Sibrandus Tiallengius pro Wonseranis; Epo Petræus, Annas Feddonius, Vibius Tzommerius, & Kempo Gellius, Con-sules, pro Snecanis; Valerius Herama Iureconsultus, & Pastor Novolandi-us, Abbæus Pastor Tyallehusius, Ulricus Oenema, Loingius, Elingus Hora-tius pro Goingiis, Regnerus Hotsemius, Iustus Emius, Auco Heronius, pro Wimbritseriis; Pibo Annius, & Gosuinus Haionius pro Bolsuerdiis, Ielme-rus Ielmerius, pro Hemclumolpherdÿs; Saco Wibrandius, & Ultius Lollius, pro Worcumanis; Titus Suffridæus pro Eloftanis; Kempo Donia, Hector Hemmema, Haringus Glinzius pro Menaldumanis; Wibrandus Sellingwirtius pro Hindelopiis, omnes Westergoi; Hommius Haersma, pro Slotanis; Hu-bertus Schofius Commendator Nessanus, pro me & Cœnobio Aelsumano, Foc-co Iskius Bornensis, Franciscus Tiepkonius, Sicco Pierius, Epo Femmius, pro Haskeriis quinque pagicis; Feddo Pastor Oelanus, Gabinius Andringa, Ferco Intiæus, & Annas Tiarckenius pro Domewerstalliis; Idsardus Pastor Echtnanus, Christianus Pierius; Annas Emius, & Hanco Meiczius pro Lem-steranis quinque pagicis; Vibius Pastor Wikelius, Ioannes Ietsomius, Rinco Sipkonius, Gasparus Hermanni pro Gasterlandis; Ioannes Luydens Pastor Ol-bercopius; Ioannes Franck, Prætor, & Christianus Lutgenius pro Stellingu-erfiis Orientalibus; Wigerus Pastor Idsartius, Lubbertus Lyclesius Prætor; Folckerus Everardus, & Andreas Sinæus pro Stellinguerfiis Occidentalibus; Ey-lardus Tyssenius, & Annas Poppius pro Scoterlandis; Gerbrandus Mintianus Prætor, Hanco Nicolaus, & Tiebbo Sanmius pro Enguerdiis, Douwo Pastor Leppenbusanus, Focco Teius Prætor, & Vitus Brunius pro Opsteranis. Notum facimus: Quandoquidem Frisiæ Ordinibus de voluntate Caroli Cæsaris Do-mini nostri Clementissimi, placuit Illustrissimum Philippum Principem Hispa-niarum, utriusque Siciliæ, & Hierosolymæ, Archiducem Austriæ, Ducem Burgundiæ & Brabantiæ, Comitem Habspurgi, Flandriæ, Hollandiæ, Domi-num Frisiæ, unicum Cæsareæ Majestatis filium, ut verum heredem declara-re, ac pro eo, à morte Caroli Patris, in successorem recipiendo fidem jura-mentumque interponere, ita nos prædicto nomine & de mandato Ordinum No-bili viro Ioanni Lignæo Comiti Arembergio, Equiti Aurei Velleris, & Cæsa-reæ Majestatis per Frisiam, Trans-Isulaniam & Groningam Præfecto, jus-jurandum fecimus hoc modo:

Nos Delegati Præsulum, Religiosorum, Nobilium, Oppidorum, Proprie-tariorumque Frisiæ, fidem facimus nos Carolo Cæsare (cui Deus longam felicemque vitam largiatur) humanis exempto Illustrissimo Duci, & Domino Phi-

page.notes: Date in the left margin printed in old numerals (clɔ. Iɔ. = MDLV). The catchword "lip-" is read from the hyphenated word at the foot and is doubtful. The whole text is set in italic type; italic is marked as one run. The line-end hyphens are kept as printed.
